formulas.name: BuildDigitalProductsStatus
formulas.expression: IF(ISCHANGED({!$Record.PMAX_Status__c}), "PMAX Status was just updated to '" & TEXT({!$Record.PMAX_Status__c}), "") & IF(ISCHANGED({!$Record.Display_Status__c}), "Display status was just updated to '" & TEXT({!$Record.Display_Status__c}), "") & IF(ISCHANGED({!$Record.Search_Status__c}), "Search Status was just updated to '" & TEXT({!$Record.Search_Status__c}), "") & IF(ISCHANGED({!$Record.Video_Status__c}), "Video Status was just updated to '" & TEXT({!$Record.Video_Status__c}), "") & IF(ISCHANGED({!$Record.VLA_Status__c}), "VLA Status was just updated to '" & TEXT({!$Record.VLA_Status__c}), "")

formulas.name: IsDigitalSEMProductsComplete
formulas.expression: AND( OR( TEXT({!$Record.Display_Status__c})= "Complete", TEXT({!$Record.Display_Status__c})= "Live", TEXT({!$Record.Display_Status__c})= "Not Executing", TEXT({!$Record.Display_Status__c})= "Cancelled" ), OR( TEXT({!$Record.PMAX_Status__c})= "Complete", TEXT({!$Record.PMAX_Status__c})= "Live", TEXT({!$Record.PMAX_Status__c})= "Not Executing", TEXT({!$Record.PMAX_Status__c})= "Cancelled" ), OR( TEXT({!$Record.Search_Status__c})= "Complete", TEXT({!$Record.Search_Status__c})= "Live", TEXT({!$Record.Search_Status__c})= "Not Executing", TEXT({!$Record.Search_Status__c})= "Cancelled" ), OR( TEXT({!$Record.Video_Status__c})= "Complete", TEXT({!$Record.Video_Status__c})= "Live", TEXT({!$Record.Video_Status__c})= "Not Executing", TEXT({!$Record.Video_Status__c})= "Cancelled" ), OR( TEXT({!$Record.VLA_Status__c})= "Complete", TEXT({!$Record.VLA_Status__c})= "Live", TEXT({!$Record.VLA_Status__c})= "Not Executing", TEXT({!$Record.VLA_Status__c})= "Cancelled" ) )

formulas.name: NotifyTheseUsers
formulas.expression: IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "Compliance Team"), {!$Record.Compliance_Team__r.Email} & ",", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "QCS_Web"), {!$Record.Website_QC__r.Email} & ",", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "Designer"), {!$Record.Designer__r.Email} & ",", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "Production Specialist"), {!$Record.Production_Specialist__r.Email} & ",", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "Production Specialist"), {!$Record.Production_Specialist__r.Email} & ",", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "Onboarding Director (Creator)"), {!$Record.CreatedBy.Email} & ",", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "RAD"), {!$Record.Account_Link__r.Regional_Account_Director__r.Email} & ",", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "AM"), {!$Record.Account_Link__r.Account_Manager__r.Email} & ",", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "Ernie Frate"), "efrate@teamvelocitymarketing.com,", "") & IF(INCLUDES({!Get_Current_Status.Project_Task_Alert__c}, "Alerted Users"), {!$Record.Alerted_User_1_Email__c} & "," & {!$Record.Alerted_User_2_Email__c}, "")
